name: Alpine Ascents
tagline: Know the mountain before you climb it

hero.title: Climb smart. Come back down.
hero.text: Alpine Ascents is a guide to mountaineering for people who want the real picture: where it came from, how it is done, what can go wrong and who to climb with. Pick a topic from the menu or start with the story below.

cards.title: History
cards.text: From Mont Blanc in 1786 to the Sherpa climbers who set today's records.

cards.title: Types and Styles
cards.text: Alpine style, expedition style, ice, rock, ski. They are not the same sport.

cards.title: Techniques
cards.text: Ropework, crampons, self-arrest, glacier travel and how to pace a long day.

cards.title: Sheltering
cards.text: Tents, bivouacs, snow caves and the huts that keep people alive.

cards.title: Hazards
cards.text: Altitude, avalanches, cold, crevasses and weather, and what to do about each.

cards.title: Records
cards.text: The fourteen 8,000 m peaks, the Seven Summits and the people behind the numbers.

cards.title: Clubs and Map
cards.text: Mountaineering clubs around the world, on a map, with distances from you.

cards.title: Success Stories
cards.text: Expeditions that worked, and what the people involved learned.

cards.title: Latest Developments
cards.text: New rules on Everest, a record season, and skimo at the Olympics.

cards.title: Guidelines
cards.text: A plain checklist for planning a first serious climb.
